# Voice Pipes

> A modular, observable real-time voice AI runtime in Rust. STT, LLM and TTS providers plug into a streaming pipeline with neural VAD, barge-in and per-turn metrics; speech-to-speech providers sit behind the same session protocol; the local stack runs with no cloud keys.

Three audiences: people building a voice agent (configure, run, deploy), people connecting a client (WebSocket protocol, SDKs), people writing a provider or component (plugin SDK).

## Getting started

- [Documentation home](README.md): the three doors and the full page list
- [Concepts](getting-started/concepts.md): pipeline, provider, session, turn, VAD vs turn detection vs barge-in, worker vs orchestrator
- [Quickstart with Docker](getting-started/quickstart-docker.md): one-command stack, ports, env vars for cloud keys
- [Quickstart from source](getting-started/quickstart-source.md): toolchain, build, models, run one stage, `live`, `serve`
- [Your first agent](getting-started/first-agent.md): swap the LLM, change the voice, tune turn-taking, serve it, go speech-to-speech

## Instructions for AI coding agents

- Configuration is one TOML file. `[stt]`/`[tts]`/`[realtime_provider]` take provider-specific keys in a nested `[x.options]` table; `[[text_processor]]` and `[[audio_post_processor]]` are flat. `client_tools_path` must precede the first table header. Unknown keys are errors.
- A cascade file has `[stt]`, `[[text_processor]]`, `[tts]`; a speech-to-speech file has `[realtime_provider]`; never both.
- Providers are Cargo features on the `voice-pipes` crate; enable them on the CLI crate as `--features voice-pipes/<feature>`. Each provider page names its feature, config block and env var.
- New providers implement the `voice-pipes-sdk` factory + provider traits in their own crate and register with one call; see the Plugin SDK guide and `voice-pipes-sdk/llms.txt`. Built-in providers also need a wizard descriptor and a docs page.
- Runtime paths never panic: factories return `ConfigError`, locks are `parking_lot`. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features "voice-pipes/realtime,voice-pipes/text-grpc" -- -D warnings` must stay clean.
- Behaviour, config or protocol changes update the matching page under docs/ and a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md. `pwsh scripts/docs-check.ps1` and `bash scripts/leak-check.sh` must pass. Never link from docs/ into docs/internal/.
